verdict.rationale: Aircall's own marketing describes AI Agents that handle after-hours calls and repetitive requests automatically, and AI Assistants that update CRM records and create follow-up tasks automatically. It also offers IVR routing combined with business-hours scheduling, so the product does ship background automations. The API, webhook and smart-routing tutorials are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of how users configure or define their own autonomous automations (triggers, workflow builder, recurring schedules), depth on the multi-tool agent actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: AI Agents handle after-hours calls, manage peak volume, and respond to repetitive requests automatically.
AI Assistants capture notes, update CRM records, and create follow-up tasks automatically
pulling order details from Shopify, processing a refund in Stripe, booking a meeting in your calendar, and logging the outcome in your CRM
Route incoming calls automatically using a keypad menu (IVR) so callers can reach the right team, combined with business-hours scheduling
